description: React Router 7 with the `@react-router/dev` Vite plugin: route config in `app/routes.ts`, SSR or pre-rendering, generated types, automatic code splitting.
Type-safe router with typed params and validated search params, cached loaders and preloading. TanStack Start adds SSR and server functions.
File-system routing in `app/` with layouts, `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx` and Server Components by default.
Remix's features became React Router 7's framework mode.
